# Noto Sans JP (bundled UI font)

The Japanese UI font the apps ship where the system's cannot be read: Android carries Noto Sans CJK as a
variable font in recent versions (seen on Android 16: CFF2), which Dear ImGui's stb_truetype does not read
(docs/design/ANDROID.md "Fonts").

- File: `NotoSansJP-Regular.otf`, Noto Sans JP Regular, version 2.004, static OpenType (CFF), 4,533,028 bytes,
  SHA-256 dff723ba59d57d136764a04b9b2d03205544f7cd785a711442d6d2d085ac5073.
- Source: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk, release `Sans2.004`, `Sans/SubsetOTF/JP/NotoSansJP-Regular.otf`
  (unmodified).
